name: act-sdlc
description: Actual's development workflow for Claude Code: Linear issues, translation, and (soon) spec, ticket, and triage commands.

auto_translate.title: Auto-translate Linear issues
auto_translate.description: When on, pasting a Linear issue URL into a prompt translates the issue into your translation language first.

translate_language.title: Translation language
translate_language.description: Country code of the target language: id (Indonesian), in (Hindi), my (Malay), jp (Japanese), and more. Run translate.mjs --list-languages for the full list.

translate_provider.title: Translation provider
translate_provider.description: Model provider used for translation. Set its API key with /act-sdlc:setup.

translate_model.title: Translation model
translate_model.description: Model ID override. Leave empty for the provider default (required for openai and openrouter).
